description: Kurusuththu Arokyanadar v. Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery and Corruption Kurusuththu Arokyanadar v. Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery and Corruption View More before Hon. Sisira de Abrew, J.
parties: Kurusuththu Arokyanadar v. Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery and Corruption Kurusuththu Arokyanadar v. Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery and Corruption View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged his conviction under Section 19 of the Bribery Act for soliciting and accepting a bribe. Held - Defence evidence created reasonable doubt due to material contradictions in evidence; soliciting charges were defective due to material discrepancy in the alleged date of the offence. Appeal allowed and Appellant acquitted of all charges.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
